name: tierA-gating
registered_before: looking at any round-6 held-out output or score (run agent in progress; main session has not opened held-out outputs)
rule: A scene may be FLAGGED (put on the default skip list) only by a reason from a tier-A Jev concept, a Sonnet-owned concept, or the user's policy rules as answered by those concepts. Tier-B and tier-C Jev concepts still produce tags (filters) but never flag on their own. Everything else (thresholds, modifiers, spans, descriptions) unchanged from frozen v10.
evaluation: offline re-score of the frozen round-6 v10 answers with the same headtohead method and bar; reported alongside the as-run v10 result, labelled pre-registered alternative
